query:
insert into ReviewRevisionAuthors (
                            latest_collection,
                            product_id,
                            review_name,
                            revision,
                            author
                        )
                        values (
                            $1,
                            $2,
                            $3,
                            $4,
                            $5
                        )
                        on conflict (
                            product_id,
                            review_name,
                            revision,
                            author
                        ) do update
                        set
                            latest_collection = excluded.latest_collection
